newsitem.title: USA: DLR GAINS GROUND AS YEN WEAKENS,DLR/MARK STEADIES.
newsitem.headline: DLR GAINS GROUND AS YEN WEAKENS,DLR/MARK STEADIES.

text.p: 0814 GMT - Dlr/mark steadies after inflation warning in Buba monthly report boosted mark across board. Dlr/yen picks up steam, yen succumbs to further weakness, mark/yen eyes 63 level. Sakakibara meets Summers today. Stg softer awaiting July jobs, June earnings data (0830 GMT), BOE inflation report (0930). Asset markets eyed after US July retail sales, PPI data (1230).
